BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE task
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS task_kind varchar(64),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS execution_mode varchar(32),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS evaluation_mode varchar(32),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ui_mode varchar(32),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submission_mode varchar(32),
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS requires_sandbox boolean,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS exposes_preview boolean,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS exposes_terminal boolean,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS supports_live_validation boolean;

UPDATE task AS t
SET
    task_kind = CASE UPPER(TRIM(cst.code))
        WHEN 'HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT' THEN 'frontend_preview'
        WHEN 'CSS_BASIC_STYLESHEET' THEN 'frontend_preview'
        WHEN 'REACT_COMPONENT_BASIC' THEN 'frontend_preview'
        WHEN 'PHP_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'fullstack_page'
        WHEN 'NEXTJS_BASIC' THEN 'fullstack_page'
        WHEN 'EXPRESSJS_BASIC' THEN 'api_endpoint'
        WHEN 'JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'cli_programming'
        WHEN 'JAVASCRIPT_BASIC' THEN 'cli_programming'
        WHEN 'TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'cli_programming'
        WHEN 'TYPESCRIPT_BASIC' THEN 'cli_programming'
        WHEN 'NODEJS_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'cli_programming'
        ELSE COALESCE(t.task_kind, 'frontend_preview')
    END,
    execution_mode = CASE UPPER(TRIM(cst.code))
        WHEN 'HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT' THEN 'BROWSER_PREVIEW'
        WHEN 'CSS_BASIC_STYLESHEET' THEN 'BROWSER_PREVIEW'
        WHEN 'REACT_COMPONENT_BASIC' THEN 'BROWSER_PREVIEW'
        WHEN 'PHP_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'BROWSER_PREVIEW'
        WHEN 'NEXTJS_BASIC' THEN 'BROWSER_PREVIEW'
        WHEN 'EXPRESSJS_BASIC' THEN 'HTTP_API'
        WHEN 'JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'TERMINAL_RUN'
        WHEN 'JAVASCRIPT_BASIC' THEN 'TERMINAL_RUN'
        WHEN 'TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'TERMINAL_RUN'
        WHEN 'TYPESCRIPT_BASIC' THEN 'TERMINAL_RUN'
        WHEN 'NODEJS_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'TERMINAL_RUN'
        ELSE COALESCE(t.execution_mode, 'BROWSER_PREVIEW')
    END,
    evaluation_mode = CASE UPPER(TRIM(cst.code))
        WHEN 'NEXTJS_BASIC' THEN 'MANUAL'
        WHEN 'EXPRESSJS_BASIC' THEN 'HYBRID'
        ELSE COALESCE(t.evaluation_mode, 'AUTO')
    END,
    ui_mode = CASE UPPER(TRIM(cst.code))
        WHEN 'EXPRESSJS_BASIC' THEN 'REPORT'
        WHEN 'JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'TERMINAL'
        WHEN 'JAVASCRIPT_BASIC' THEN 'TERMINAL'
        WHEN 'TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'TERMINAL'
        WHEN 'TYPESCRIPT_BASIC' THEN 'TERMINAL'
        WHEN 'NODEJS_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN 'TERMINAL'
        ELSE COALESCE(t.ui_mode, 'PREVIEW')
    END,
    submission_mode = COALESCE(t.submission_mode, 'SNAPSHOT'),
    requires_sandbox = COALESCE(t.requires_sandbox, TRUE),
    exposes_preview = CASE UPPER(TRIM(cst.code))
        WHEN 'JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN FALSE
        WHEN 'JAVASCRIPT_BASIC' THEN FALSE
        WHEN 'TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN FALSE
        WHEN 'TYPESCRIPT_BASIC' THEN FALSE
        WHEN 'NODEJS_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN FALSE
        WHEN 'EXPRESSJS_BASIC' THEN FALSE
        ELSE COALESCE(t.exposes_preview, TRUE)
    END,
    exposes_terminal = CASE UPPER(TRIM(cst.code))
        WHEN 'JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN TRUE
        WHEN 'JAVASCRIPT_BASIC' THEN TRUE
        WHEN 'TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN TRUE
        WHEN 'TYPESCRIPT_BASIC' THEN TRUE
        WHEN 'NODEJS_BASIC_SCRIPT' THEN TRUE
        ELSE COALESCE(t.exposes_terminal, FALSE)
    END,
    supports_live_validation = CASE UPPER(TRIM(cst.code))
        WHEN 'NEXTJS_BASIC' THEN FALSE
        ELSE COALESCE(t.supports_live_validation, TRUE)
    END
FROM code_structure_type AS cst
WHERE cst.id = t.code_structure_type_id;

UPDATE task
SET
    task_kind = COALESCE(task_kind, 'frontend_preview'),
    execution_mode = COALESCE(execution_mode, 'BROWSER_PREVIEW'),
    evaluation_mode = COALESCE(evaluation_mode, 'AUTO'),
    ui_mode = COALESCE(ui_mode, 'PREVIEW'),
    submission_mode = COALESCE(submission_mode, 'SNAPSHOT'),
    requires_sandbox = COALESCE(requires_sandbox, TRUE),
    exposes_preview = COALESCE(exposes_preview, TRUE),
    exposes_terminal = COALESCE(exposes_terminal, FALSE),
    supports_live_validation = COALESCE(supports_live_validation, TRUE);

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN task_kind SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN execution_mode SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN evaluation_mode SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN ui_mode SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN submission_mode SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN requires_sandbox SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN exposes_preview SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN exposes_terminal SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN supports_live_validation SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN task_kind SET DEFAULT 'frontend_preview',
    ALTER COLUMN execution_mode SET DEFAULT 'BROWSER_PREVIEW',
    ALTER COLUMN evaluation_mode SET DEFAULT 'AUTO',
    ALTER COLUMN ui_mode SET DEFAULT 'PREVIEW',
    ALTER COLUMN submission_mode SET DEFAULT 'SNAPSHOT',
    ALTER COLUMN requires_sandbox SET DEFAULT TRUE,
    ALTER COLUMN exposes_preview SET DEFAULT TRUE,
    ALTER COLUMN exposes_terminal SET DEFAULT FALSE,
    ALTER COLUMN supports_live_validation SET DEFAULT TRUE;

COMMIT;
